Synthetic TVTMS file, written for tests in the format of STEPBible's TVTMS. It holds no real TVTMS rows.
Differences between KJV and other  English versions:
NA/ SBLG	NET2full/ NRSV	ESV	NIV	KJV	MAPPINGS  * = KJV
*3Jn.1:14-15	*3Jn.1:14-15	*3Jn.1:14-15	3Jn.1:14	3Jn.1:14	synthetic
*Php.1:16	*Php.1:16	*Php.1:16	*Php.1:16	Php.1:17	synthetic
*Php.1:17	*Php.1:17	*Php.1:17	*Php.1:17	Php.1:16	synthetic
Rev.12:17	Rev.12:17	Rev.12:17a	Rev.12:17	Rev.12:17	
So, for a synthetic test the mappings are as above.
